verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's how-it-works page says its agent can take action through customer MCP servers inside its workflows. That is a first-party claim of MCP-client capability. The rest of the MCP evidence describes Lorikeet's own MCP server, which serves other assistants, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation on how to register or configure external MCP servers, supported transports and auth, tool discovery and scoping details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: The agent takes action through your APIs and MCP servers inside natural-language and deterministic workflows
